description: H8 public audit findings (docs/audit/h8-public-audit-report.md). Gate: 0 unfixed critical/high; every 'fixed' finding cites its fix_ref; all four areas (consensus/vm/bridge/wallet) appear.

findings.title: keystore loader did not enforce owner-only directory permissions
key access log format could record secret material
ParameterChange governance payload validated updated params only after the fact
verify.rs frame pops rely on a checked len() invariant (frames.len()<2 / ==1 guards); unwrap() is reachable only behind those guards
23 truncating numeric casts (as u32/u16/u8) in aura-exec audited: each applies to decoder-bounded quantities (LEB128 masks, arities, post-limit lengths); none truncates unchecked external data
bridge is E9 (Stage 2, not implemented in this tree); audit slot retained so the area cannot silently disappear from scope
no public disclosure policy or bug bounty program existed before H8
